page_title: RMA 3-1 VIL | Real Madrid v Villarreal 04/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Guillermo Cuadra is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' A rebound sits up nicely for Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, balloons high over the bar and out for a goal kick.
90+4' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
90+3' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
90+2' Great interplay ends with Rodrygo playing a simple pass to Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid), who steadies himself and curls a shot from mid-range agonisingly wide of the left post.
90+1' Real Madrid take a short corner kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.

90' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Madrid.
90' Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid).
88' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) volleys the ball from just outside the box, but his effort goes narrowly over the bar.
86' Substitution. Santi Comesana is replaced by Dani Parejo (Villarreal).
86' The number of offsides is – 0:0.
83' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Rodrygo.
82' The substitution is prepared. Adria Altimira (Villarreal) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi.
82' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

81' 3 - 1 It's a goal! Brahim Diaz plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 3:1.

80' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Arnau Tenas pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom left corner.
78' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Arnau Tenas, who smothers the ball.
78' The ball goes out for a corner. Real Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.
77' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) obviously did not learn his lesson after the first yellow card because he has been shown a second one by the referee!
75' Xabi Alonso decides to make a substitution. Franco Mastantuono will be replaced by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid).
73' Substitution. Pape Gueye makes his way off the pitch and Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) comes on as his replacement.
73' 2 - 1 Goal! Pape Gueye slips it to Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom left corner with a great effort. The score is 2:1.

72' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Arnau Tenas to get hold of the ball.

72' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Arnau Tenas is alert and denies him with a nice save.
69' 2 - 0 Goal! Arnau Tenas gets a hand on the penalty from Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
69' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is going to take the penalty!
69' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.

68' Rafa Marin (Villarreal) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Real Madrid are awarded a penalty kick!
66' 16:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. Shots on target – 2:1.
64' It will be a substitution. Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) is ready to enter the pitch as Dani Ceballos walks off.
64' Xabi Alonso has decided to substitute Arda Guler and he is replaced by Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid).
64' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
62' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
61' The attendance for today's match is 75216.
60' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
57' Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) tries his luck but the attempt goes well wide of the right post.
56' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

56' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. A rebound falls for Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid), who immediately lets rip with a howitzer of a shot from distance. The effort, however, is bravely blocked by a defender. Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
52' A pass by Arda Guler (Real Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
49' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

47' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) displays superb quick feet and dribbling as he jinks his way through multiple challenges and takes a shot from inside the box, which is deflected and goes past stranded Arnau Tenas. 1:0.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Marcelino gives a chance to Georges Mikautadze and Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) is off.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marcelino probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal). He is replaced by Nicolas Pepe.
46' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
43' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
42' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi plays a pass to Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball flies well wide of the left post.

41' Thibaut Courtois was forced into action to thwart Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
40' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) tries to find Kylian Mbappe with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
39' Thomas Partey (Villarreal) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.

37' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort. Arda Guler (Real Madrid) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
36' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Pape Gueye (Villarreal). Real Madrid win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
34' Thomas Partey (Villarreal) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
33' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
32' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) attempts to find his teammate with a short pass into the box. Kylian Mbappe collects the ball, but his attack is thwarted by the defence.
32' The total number of attempts is 8:2. The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
30' Thomas Partey (Villarreal) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
30' The ball is cleared after Pape Gueye (Villarreal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
29' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Thibaut Courtois.
27' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) anticipates the cross from Franco Mastantuono, but powers his header way over the bar from the edge of the six-yard box.
27' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. He hits the ball poorly and sends it into orbit.
22' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the corner with a short pass.

22' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Real Madrid earn a corner.
22' Vinicius Junior crosses and Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) misses a great opportunity with his head from close in, sending the ball just wide of the right post.
21' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
20' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) gets inside the box and tries to beat Arnau Tenas with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
20' Wasted effort! Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
19' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
17' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
16' The ball possession is 81:19.
13' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
12' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
10' Real Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
8' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
7' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a pass from Kylian Mbappe inside the box and quickly shoots, but the effort goes inches over the bar.
5' Poor challenge! Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) is penalised for tripping and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle.
4' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
3' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
2' Real Madrid enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Villarreal will have the kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra will officiate today.
